caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring a partially ruined stone building colored with light red and off-white, with openings outlined in dark red and brown; it has tall, narrow windows and an arched doorway, with one section forming a tower on the left. In the foreground, three four-legged animals, colored in shades of tan, light brown, and cream, are grazing on blue and green ground. The background contains a body of blue water with horizontal white streaks, flanked by green patches representing land, with stylized trees on the right side bearing dark green foliage and reddish-brown trunks. Hills or mountains, drawn in green and reddish-brown, are visible in the distant background. The sky is rendered in a flat blue tone, and the entire scene is framed by a rectangle on a beige or cream-colored plain background. There is also a small faint rectangular outline with rounded corners in the lower right corner of the background area outside the main scene.
title: Bandbox Design
